one_liner: Harvest (time tracking) v2 REST API is open to all accounts including free/trial, with personal access tokens and OAuth2 authorization-code flow; vendor also ships an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token from Harvest ID Developers section, or full OAuth2 flow allowing other users to use integrations. Requests need Harvest-Account-Id and User-Agent headers.
access_notes: All Harvest accounts, including free and trial, have API access; permissions mirror account roles.
blocker_notes: Evidence from greenhouse/harvestapi.io/NetApp results refers to different products named Harvest and was ignored.

evidence.quote: Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.
The API can be accessed by creating a Personal Access Token from the Developers section of Harvest ID.
Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts) which can be used to manage your Harvest account.
The following HTTP methods are supported: GET POST PATCH DELETE
The Harvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection lets you work with your Harvest data through an AI assistant, using plain language instead of clicking through the app.
